summary:
## Standing operator rules
- “please keep commits small so review stays easy.”
- “Goal for this session: replace the hand-rolled retry loop in ledgerly/sync/client.py with tenacity.” Superseded by: “Stop the tenacity refactor, we will revisit it next sprint. New priority: the nightly reconciliation job in ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py is double-counting refunds; fix that.”
- “Always pin new licensing tools to an exact version in requirements/license-tools.txt rather than using >= or a floating latest version.”
- Run procedure “Elasticsearch Reindex Alias Swap” between other work, in order, one at a time: the specified `curl` commands for health, mapping, `orders_v2` creation, reindex, count validation, source write block, atomic alias swap, and target unblock.
- “Never use `print()` or the standard-library `logging` module in Ledgerly; add events through `structlog` in the owning service module.”
- Do not add an invoice covering index; it doubled ingest write latency.
- “The ci-runner-small pool is being retired and jobs there hang; integration jobs must target ci-runner-arm64 from now on.”
- “can you paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing?”

## Recent work
Elasticsearch steps 1–3 are complete; next is reindex. Invoice pagination changes remain uncommitted. Negative credit lines and grouped money formatting are fixed. The latest change reduced continuation-page header reservation from 54 to 36 points after an 86-item invoice produced 3 pages instead of 2; rerun the exact focused test and full PDF suite.
